scenes.name: A knot forms
scenes.what: Rest; then three minutes of stress; then the stress eases to a level that is held.

scenes.name: Slow breathing
scenes.what: Thirty slow breaths, four seconds in and six out, while the stress is held.

scenes.name: Attention, no touch
scenes.what: The same thirty breaths, with attention resting on the spot.

scenes.name: A resting hand
scenes.what: A hand rests on the spot for a minute, with slow breaths; then it lifts.

scenes.name: Subtle breaths, attending
scenes.what: Small sips in and long, slow releases out, a third the size of a slow breath, with attention resting on the spot.

scenes.name: Rolling
scenes.what: A roller presses a quiet corner once every three seconds for three minutes, then stops.

scenes.name: After one lets go
scenes.what: A hand rests on the knot at the spot until it lets go (a minute at most); the slow breaths go on for ten minutes more.

scenes.name: An hour of moods
scenes.what: For an hour the stress rises and falls, as moods do.

scenes.name: Stress lingers
scenes.what: Half an hour more at the holding stress.

layout.note: a parent every 10 mm feeding four children: a small vessel every 4-5 mm

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: The patch a shut vessel starves signals through its own nerve: a held, achy place, felt without touching, and a tingle as it lets go. A held, tender place, in 12 of 19 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on the oxygen debt at which a small artery's territory is tender (perforators): likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the oxygen debt at which a small artery's territory is tender (perforators)

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find, only tenderness where it presses. Its shut artery, about 0.31 mm across and 10 mm down, is felt at about 2% of what a finger can find (at most 13%, where the fat is thinnest): nothing firm, in all 19 settings.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Where a small artery comes up through the deep fascia, under the skin and fat, in trees: a parent with its children around it. They gather where stress is held most, in all 19 settings.
traits.cell: at the fascia, on its vessels

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Small arteries come up one every 4-5 mm: 5.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 20 hold in this 4 cm patch (1.2 to the square centimetre); in 13 of 32 settings none can hold at all. A body has on the order of 100,000 such vessels (estimated from their spacing; 374 major ones, taylor1987).
traits.depends: depends most on width of the length–tension curve: likelier the higher it is

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: A vessel shuts when its tone passes the fold of its switch; a parent that shuts takes its children with it. They appear within seconds of a stressful moment (the first after about 3 s), in all 19 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 19 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 28 of 32 settings: pressure outside a vessel keeps it shut only while it lasts. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in none of 4 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure a hand or roller brings to a knot: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: pressure a hand or roller brings to a knot

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 18 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.
traits.depends: depends most on width of the length–tension curve: likelier the lower it is

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 17 of 19 settings; where they do, about 80% of them, most often at the bottom of the breath, as the in-breath begins (30% of releases), the typical one at breath 2; one within the first two breaths in 12 of 17 settings. The out-breath eases tone and the in-breath raises it again, so a knot lets go when the easing outlasts the rise.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 10 of 19 settings. Drive is not local: attention changes only how much the breath moves the tissue at the spot. If attention could aim the breath's calming at one place (a hypothesis), it would in 10 of 19 settings.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 7 of 19 settings, after about 8 s; across the patch about 7% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 74%). Small breaths move the tissue little and change drive little: what is left is attention concentrating their movement at the spot.
traits.depends: depends most on maximal active wall tension: likelier the higher it is

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: Never while the hand still presses, in all 19 settings. It lets go within seconds of the hand lifting, in 16 of 19 settings. A vessel pressed shut cannot reopen until the pressure lifts.
traits.cell: as the hand lifts (never under it)

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. As it opens, blood floods the starved patch.
traits.cell: tenderness fades over a minute or so

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: As blood returns the vessel's nerve bursts: a tingle over the patch it feeds. 345 of the 460 releases in the breathing and hand scenes came with one, in 17 of 19 settings.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in all 16 settings (about 9); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 9 of 16 settings, and the same one holds again in none of 16 settings (the first return after about 34 s). In a tree a parent's knot shuts its children, and its release lets most of them go.
traits.cell: others go with it · one moves in nearby

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends, a knot held three hours lets go with it, in all 32 settings. If the wall's muscle adapts to being shut, as smooth muscle held at a new length does, an old knot outlasts its stress in 4 of 32 settings, while one held half an hour lets go in 17 of 32 settings.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Laser speckle over the spot sees the skin's flow rise from 0.00 to 1.34 of resting flow as it lets go (the median of 16 releases), while the sham stays at 0.90 to 0.95. A press flushes every place it presses, so the control is a pressed place with no knot.

layout.note: a few candidate places along the zone where the muscle's nerve enters it

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Its acid, sensitising milieu stirs the muscle's nerves: an ache felt from inside. A held, tender place, in 19 of 22 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: A small firm nodule on a taut band, about the size measured by ultrasound (0.16 cm², sikdar2009). About 15 mm down, in the muscle. A finger can find it in 6 of 22 settings where knots hold; in the rest it lies below the edge of touch.
traits.cell: a small nodule on a band, often too faint
traits.depends: depends most on the fat beneath the skin, over the upper trapezius: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the fat beneath the skin, over the upper trapezius

traits.label: Where
traits.text: In the muscle, along the zone where its nerve enters it: a few candidate places, not everywhere. They gather where stress is held most, in all 22 settings.
traits.cell: in muscle, where its nerve enters

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Candidate places along the innervation zone, a few in each muscle: 0.3 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 4 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.2 to the square centimetre); in 10 of 32 settings none can hold at all. A body has a few hundred such places (300 taken as representative).
traits.depends: depends most on how steeply relaxation needs energy: likelier the higher it is

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress raises endplate activity; the contraction squeezes its capillaries, and the starved sarcomeres cannot let go: an energy crisis. They build during a stressful moment, over a minute or two (the first after about 58 s), in all 22 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 22 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in all 32 settings: a brief press adds a little ischaemia, not enough to start a crisis where none is near.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 12 of 22 settings; where they do, about 75% of them, most often at the bottom of the breath, as the in-breath begins (30% of releases), the typical one at breath 16; one within the first two breaths in 7 of 12 settings. Relaxation lowers endplate activity, and the breath's movement stretches the band.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 12 of 22 settings. Attention concentrates the breath's stretch at the spot. If attention could aim the breath's calming at one place (a hypothesis), it would in 7 of 22 settings.

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 9 of 22 settings, after about 3 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 25%). Small breaths stretch the band little; the calm they bring lowers endplate activity a little.
traits.depends: depends most on how much a breath moves the tissue at a knot: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much a breath moves the tissue at a knot

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It lets go under the hand, in 14 of 22 settings, after about 18 s; as it lifts in 1 of 22 settings. Sustained pressure lengthens the contracture slowly, over the tens of seconds of pressure release.
traits.depends: depends most on pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: pressure that stops flow in the muscle's capillaries

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: The firmness goes over minutes; the tenderness fades over a minute or so. The contracture relaxes as energy returns.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: A release fast enough twitches: the local twitch response. 254 of the 357 releases in the breathing and hand scenes came with one, in 8 of 22 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how much a stretch loosens the contracture: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how much a stretch loosens the contracture

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 8 of 17 settings (about 2); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 7 of 17 settings, and the same one holds again in 8 of 17 settings (the first return after about 7 s). Nothing here links one trigger point to another: the key point and its satellites are not in the patch yet.
traits.cell: one moves in nearby · it comes back

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: Its slow sustaining factors, over weeks, are not modelled yet.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Elastography through the pressing probe sees the nodule's contracture fall from 0.57 to 0.46 over the tens of seconds around its release (the median of 11), under the hand; a needle in it finds the endplate still active (3.0 times its typical level before, 3.1 after): the press lengthens the band, it does not quiet the endplate. Nothing changes in the skin.

layout.note: motor units' territories, 5-10 mm across, running along the fibres

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Its contraction and its metabolites are sensed by the muscle's own sensors: a clench or an ache, felt from inside. A held, tender place, in 30 of 32 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: A firm band along the fibres, 5-10 mm wide and a few centimetres long: a motor unit's territory contracted. Overlapping units make it firmer. About 15 mm down, in the muscle. A finger can find it in all 32 settings where knots hold; in the rest it lies below the edge of touch.
traits.cell: a firm band along the fibres

traits.label: Where
traits.text: In the muscle, wherever its motor units lie: territories 5 mm apart and overlapping. They gather where stress is held most, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Motor units whose territories lie under the patch (64 representative): 4.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 18 hold in this 4 cm patch (1.1 to the square centimetre).

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Stress recruits motor units; some latch on and keep firing after the stress eases, kept on by the metabolites of their own contraction. They build during a stressful moment, over a minute or two (the first after about 61 s), in 15 of 32 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 28 of 32 settings: the roller excites the units it presses, but where the drive is far below their threshold none latches. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in all 4 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how far a firing unit squeezes its own supply: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how far a firing unit squeezes its own supply

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods, knots come and go (some form and let go at least twice), in all 32 settings.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 17 of 32 settings; where they do, about 14% of them, most often at the bottom of the breath, as the in-breath begins (49% of releases), the typical one at breath 8; one within the first two breaths in 16 of 17 settings. The breath lowers the descending drive and the monoamines that deepen the latch.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 16 of 32 settings. Attention at a place inhibits its units.
traits.depends: depends most on how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress: likelier the higher it is

depends_on.label: how far minutes of slow breathing lower stress

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 6 of 32 settings, after about 11 s; across the patch about 0% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 5%). Attention inhibits the units at the spot whatever the breath's size; the breath itself adds little.
traits.depends: depends most on the loop: how strongly a unit's own metabolites drive it: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: the loop: how strongly a unit's own metabolites drive it

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: It lets go under the hand, in 22 of 32 settings, after about 10 s. A held hand excites the units under it for a moment and then inhibits them (which a hand does is not known; the other variant follows). If a held hand only excited the units under it, it would let go under the hand in 2 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how fast that warm-up builds and fades: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how fast that warm-up builds and fades

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: The firmness goes at once; the tenderness fades over minutes. The unit falls silent and its fibres relax: an unclenching.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No tingle at a release: nothing in a motor unit falling silent makes one.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in all 22 settings (about 6); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in 21 of 22 settings, and the same one holds again in 9 of 22 settings (the first return after about 4 s). Neighbouring units share the metabolites' drive, so a latched unit can hand its load to one nearby.
traits.cell: others go with it · one moves in nearby · it comes back

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Surface EMG that picks out single motor units sees the knot's unit fall silent at the moment it lets go (7 units firing under the electrode before, 0 after, the median of 16 releases), and elastography sees the firmness at the spot fall from 8.9 to 6.3 times the edge of touch. The skin's flow does not change.

layout.note: places on the body map, about 10 mm apart

traits.label: Felt from inside
traits.text: Felt from inside is all it is: a place the nervous system turns up. A held, tender place, in all 32 settings.

traits.label: Found by a finger
traits.text: Nothing firm for a finger to find: nothing in the tissue changes. What a finger meets is an ordinary structure, felt more.

traits.label: Where
traits.text: Wherever the body map tells places apart, about 10 mm on the back: broad and soft-edged. They do not gather where stress is held, in 29 of 32 settings: they sit where ordinary input happens to be loudest, and arousal raises every place at once.

traits.label: How many
traits.text: Places on the body map, about 10 mm apart: 1.0 to the square centimetre. After a stressful moment about 6 hold in this 4 cm patch (0.4 to the square centimetre).

traits.label: How they form
traits.text: Arousal turns up what is felt, most where stress is held and the muscles guard. They appear within seconds of a stressful moment (the first after about 1 s), in all 32 settings. Some places are felt as knots even at rest, before any stress, in 11 of 32 settings.

traits.label: While stress lingers
traits.text: While the stress lingers they stay as they are, in 29 of 32 settings.

traits.label: Pressed or rolled
traits.text: Rolling a quiet place brings none out, in 30 of 32 settings: a press is felt while it lasts. In the rest it brings one out, which stays after it stops in 1 of 2 settings.

traits.label: With moods
traits.text: Over an hour of moods they hold steady, in 18 of 32 settings; some come and go in the rest.

traits.label: To slow breathing
traits.text: Over thirty slow breaths some let go, in 14 of 32 settings; where they do, about 57% of them, most often early in the out-breath (40% of releases), the typical one at breath 12; one within the first two breaths in 4 of 14 settings. A slow breath eases arousal and is felt as safety; the in-breath is felt a little less.

traits.label: To attention, without touch
traits.text: With attention resting on the spot and no touch, the knot there lets go where the same breaths alone would not, or sooner, in 15 of 32 settings. Attention first turns up what is felt there, then, with the breath, quiets it.
traits.depends: depends most on how uneven ordinary input is from place to place: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how uneven ordinary input is from place to place

traits.label: To subtle breaths, attending
traits.text: With subtle breaths, a third the size of a slow breath, and attention resting on the spot, the knot there lets go in 13 of 32 settings, after about 300 s; across the patch about 15% let go (with thirty slow breaths, 0%). Attention with safety quiets a place whatever the breath's size.
traits.depends: depends most on how fast attention with safety quiets a place: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how fast attention with safety quiets a place

traits.label: Under a resting hand
traits.text: Never while the hand still presses, in all 32 settings. It does not let go within the scene, in 25 of 32 settings; as it lifts in 7 of 32 settings. A hand adds input and draws attention: the place is felt more under it.
traits.cell: not within a minute (never under it)

traits.label: How it lets go
traits.text: Nothing firm to go; the tenderness fades at once. What goes is what is felt.

traits.label: A spark
traits.text: No tingle at a release: its tingling comes only from overbreathing, in the hands, face and trunk at once.

traits.label: After one lets go
traits.text: When the knot at the spot lets go, others go with it within ten seconds in 7 of 8 settings (about 1); within ten minutes a new one holds nearby in none of 8 settings, and the same one holds again in 1 of 8 settings (the first return after about 64 s). Attention moves to the next loudest place, and the loudest knot quiets the others.

traits.label: Held for hours
traits.text: When its stress ends a knot lets go, however long it was held, in 20 of 32 settings.
traits.depends: depends most on how close ordinary input is to being felt as a knot: likelier the lower it is

depends_on.label: how close ordinary input is to being felt as a knot

traits.label: What an instrument would record
traits.text: Nothing in the tissue changes: skin flow, muscle activity and stiffness stay as they were. Only the report changes: what is felt at the spot falls from 2.43 to 0.75 of the level felt as a knot (the median of 7 releases).

not_yet.name: Vascular latch
not_yet.why: It shares the vessel and how a held vessel sets; the latch itself needs its rate constants (Hai & Murphy 1988). The latch saves energy and does not remember: as a knot it would hold only while its drive lasts, and let go over tens of seconds once drive falls.

not_yet.name: Densification
not_yet.why: To model as a loose layer that stiffens at rest and thins with movement and warmth: its knots would be broad and slow, freed by movement over minutes.

not_yet.name: Nerves
not_yet.why: To model as a sensitised nerve where it pierces the fascia: tender, with nothing firm to feel, tingling along its branches when pressed, and freed only when what presses on it lets go.
